reference_question: Summarize the key information in this document.
user_question: Can you provide a summary of the key information in this document?
answer: This is a Newport Racing Event Survey for an event held at Laguna Seca, Monterey, CA on September 10, 1995. The San Jose division managed the event, with T.L. Roberts as Division Manager. Promotional materials included 720 mugs, 40 counter displays, 20 floor displays, and 100 posters, received on 6/12/95. 40 customers were invited with 35 attending, alongside 10 Lorillard personnel. The invitations were sent out on 9/5/95 and received on 9/6/95. Total event attendance was 100,000, with 35-40 people in the Newport hospitality tent. The hospitality tent received ratings of Average for food and Excellent for both cleanliness and service. The survey included positive feedback from several retailers and wholesalers. The main suggestion for improvement was to send tickets out earlier, as they arrived just three days before the event. The survey was submitted on 9/26/95, within the required 30-day window.
